snippet.title: AstroScaper - What Is AstroScaper? (Gameplay Overview)
snippet.description:
New to AstroScaper?

This narrated gameplay overview explains the core mechanics, progression, and what makes AstroScaper a unique relaxing sci-fi puzzle city-builder.

Build across procedurally generated asteroids, discover powerful building synergies, optimize every placement, and create your perfect space colony at your own pace.

Steam ‣ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3579350?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=gameplay_trailer&utm_content=description_link
Discord ‣ https://discord.gg/PSp4rgqRm6

🎵 Music:
